name: config_precedence_resolve
title: Resolve Config Precedence
prompt: read_file config/defaults.env, config/prod.env, config/local.env, docs/precedence.md. Merge with local > prod > defaults. Submit exactly 'API_TIMEOUT=N RETRIES=N FEATURE_X=value' (only those three keys).

docs/precedence.md: For this service, local overrides prod, and prod overrides defaults.
